task: Recover from running an application command in the repository root
action: Classify the bounded command error, rerun checks in their owning directories, and record prevention
classification_basis: npm test was invoked from the repository root although package.json belongs to apps/effort-avatar
applicable_rules: General mistakes use the full bounded mistake-response flow
Commands must be verified in the directory that owns their configuration

assignment_decision.rationale: The impact is a single failed read-only test command with no repository mutation; independent review would not proportionally reduce risk

required_checks: app tests and build pass from apps/effort-avatar
repository tests and state checks pass from repository root
stop_conditions: Do not treat the failed command as an application failure
Do not proceed with an incomplete test result

evidence.result: npm scripts are owned by the application directory
failed command made no file changes and only interrupted validation
app-owned npm commands and repository-owned Python commands were the affected categories
run each command group with the directory that owns its configuration
12 app tests and 50 repository tests passed
root invocation fails with package.json ENOENT as expected
not required for a first bounded non-mutating command-location error
no meaning, authority, production, merge, or paid-service change
repository-owned state check passed from repository root
